# Visual Studio Code GUI Interface Description

## Window Header

- **Application Title Bar**
  - Left: "Activities" text indicating the Linux desktop environment.
  - Center: "Visual Studio Code" as the application name.
  - Right: System status icons including:
    - Date and time: "Oct 23 01:21"
    - Notification bell icon
    - System tray icons (network, sound, power)

- **Window Control Buttons**
  - Top-right corner: Minimize, Maximize/Restore, and Close buttons (standard Linux window controls)

## Menu Bar

- **Main Menu Items**
  - File
  - Edit
  - Selection
  - View
  - Go
  - Run
  - Terminal
  - Help

## Left Sidebar (Activity Bar)

- **Icons from Top to Bottom**
  - **Explorer Icon** (with tooltip "Explorer (Ctrl+Shift+E)")
  - **Search Icon**
  - **Source Control Icon**
  - **Debug Icon**
  - **Extensions Icon**
  - **Terminal Icon**
  - **Settings Icon** (with a notification badge showing "1")

## Main Content Area

### Welcome Page

- **Main Title**
  - "Visual Studio Code"
  - Subtitle: "Editing evolved"

- **Start Section**
  - **Options List**
    - "New File..." (with document icon)
    - "Open File..." (with folder icon)
    - "Open Folder..." (with folder icon)
    - "Connect to..." (with arrow icon)

- **Recent Section**
  - Text: "You have no recent folders, open a folder to start."

### Walkthroughs Section

- **Title**: "Walkthroughs"

- **Walkthrough Cards**
  - **Card 1: "Get Started with VS Code"**
    - Description: "Customize your editor, learn the basics, and start coding"
    - Status: Highlighted with blue underline, indicating it is selected or active
    - Icon: Star icon

  - **Card 2: "Learn the Fundamentals"**
    - Description: Not visible in the provided image
    - Icon: Lightbulb icon

## Status Bar

- **Bottom Left**
  - **Status Indicators**
    - Git status indicators: "0" commits ahead, "0" behind, "0" untracked files
    - "0" errors, "0" warnings

- **Bottom Center**
  - **Checkbox**: "Show welcome page on startup" (checked)

- **Bottom Right**
  - **Icon**: A small icon indicating the presence of a notification or extension

## System Environment

- **Desktop Environment**
  - Linux-based (indicated by "Activities" in the top-left corner)
  - GNOME desktop environment (implied by the UI style and system icons)

- **Application Dock**
  - Left sidebar contains application icons including:
    - Google Chrome
    - Thunderbird
    - Visual Studio Code (active)
    - VLC Media Player
    - LibreOffice Writer
    - LibreOffice Calc
    - LibreOffice Impress
    - GIMP
    - File Manager
    - Software Center
    - Help
    - Trash

- **Bottom Panel**
  - **Grid Icon**: Application launcher grid
  - **User Icon**: User account icon
  - **Settings Icon**: With notification badge "1"
  - **Status Indicators**: Git status, error/warning indicators

## Visual Design

- **Color Scheme**
  - Dark theme with black background
  - Light gray and white text
  - Blue highlights for active elements

- **Typography**
  - Clean, sans-serif font
  - Hierarchical text sizes for headings and body text

- **Layout**
  - Left sidebar for navigation
  - Center content area for main actions and information
  - Top menu bar for global commands
  - Bottom status bar for system and application status

## Functional Elements

- **Interactive Elements**
  - Clickable menu items
  - Interactive walkthrough cards
  - Status indicators that can be toggled

- **Keyboard Shortcuts**
  - Explorer: Ctrl+Shift+E (tooltip visible)

- **Notifications**
  - Settings icon with badge "1" indicating pending actions or updates
  - Welcome page checkbox for user preference

## Contextual Information

- **Application State**
  - Welcome page is displayed
  - No recent folders opened
  - "Get Started with VS Code" walkthrough is selected

- **User Environment**
  - Linux desktop environment
  - No active projects or files open
  - User has not yet opened a folder or file

- **System Status**
  - No errors or warnings
  - No pending notifications (except for settings badge)
  - System time is 01:21 on October 23
